_preregistration.geometry_justification: cheapest geometry on the ladder that recovers DK's known exponents within 20% INCLUDING its seed spread (F56)
_preregistration.grid_justification: 0.400 dropped (theta fit R^2=0.007, absorbing phase); 0.475/0.500 added because delta's crossing is not bracketed by the old grid while theta's is -- registered before the first run, not after a null
_preregistration.primary: do the bootstrap 90% intervals for T_c(delta) and T_c(theta) overlap?
_preregistration.gate: if the inline DK calibration at N=192/120 does not clear 20% including its spread, the result is NOT DECIDABLE and no DP claim is licensed
_preregistration.order: seed-major, so an interruption leaves every temperature equally sampled
_preregistration.visit_order: per_replica (F57): each replica draws its own, so 512 replicas are 512 independent draws; twins share an order stream to preserve CRN
_preregistration.bootstrap_unit: replica -- valid only because of the per_replica order
_preregistration.resumable: every completed run is saved immediately and keyed by (T, seed)

calibration_at_run_geometry.gate: mean deviation PLUS its seed-to-seed spread must clear the tolerance

verdict: DP-CONSISTENT: delta and theta reach their DP values at overlapping temperatures, T_c in [0.4343, 0.4391]. delta's 90% interval is [0.4343, 0.444] and theta's is [0.4325, 0.4391]. The estimator was shown at this geometry to recover DK's known exponents to 9.8+/-8.1% and 9.2+/-5.6%, so the agreement is a measurement rather than a fit-window artifact. These are the first LM exponents worth quoting against directed percolation, with that bias stated.

_analysis_provenance.note: sha256 of the analysis source at write time. If this does not match the file on disk, the analysis was produced by a different version of the code -- re-run it before reading the numbers (issue #38).

_note: Does the token-lattice CA's damage-spreading transition sit in the directed percolation universality class? Run at N=192 over 120 sweeps -- the cheapest geometry on the scanned ladder that demonstrably recovers Domany-Kinzel's KNOWN exponents within the 20% dp_pipeline_validation pre-registered, counting the seed-to-seed spread. Phase 2 ran N=96/40, where the same estimator misses DK's delta by a fifth, and its 'not in the DP class' verdict was withdrawn as a fit-window artifact (F56). The temperature grid drops 0.400 (theta fit R^2=0.007, absorbing phase) and adds 0.475/0.500 because delta's crossing was not bracketed by the phase-2 grid while theta's was -- a test of whether two crossings coincide is vacuous when one lies outside the grid. The primary test is whether the bootstrap intervals for the two crossing temperatures OVERLAP, which is the physical statement and is robust to a coarse grid; the phase-2 per-point tolerance test is reported alongside but does not decide. The calibration gate is evaluated on DK alone, blind to the LM numbers, so it cannot be tuned to the answer.
